'''Wolfgang Anton Herrmann''' (born 18 April 1948) is a German [[chemist]] and [[Academic administration|academic administrator]]. From 1995 to 2019, he was President of the [[Technical University of Munich]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Curriculum Vitae|url=https://wwwt3.ch.tum.de/en/faculty/staff/former-members/wah/cv-wah/|access-date=27 December 2020|website=[[TUM Department of Chemistry]]}}</ref>

== Education ==
Herrmann attended the Donau-Gymnasium [[Kelheim]], where he passed the [[Abitur]] in 1967. He then studied [[chemistry]] at the [[Technical University of Munich]] on a scholarship from [[Cusanuswerk]], where he wrote his diploma thesis in 1971 under the supervision of [[Ernst Otto Fischer]], a later [[Nobel Prize in Chemistry|Nobel Prize]] laureate. He received his doctorate in 1973 at the [[University of Regensburg]]. After a research fellowship of the [[Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft]] with [[Philip Skell]] at the [[Pennsylvania State University]] from 1975 to 1976, he [[Habilitation|habilitated]] at the [[University of Regensburg]] in 1978.<ref name="Leopoldina">{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=Curriculum Vitae Professor Dr. Wolfgang A. Herrmann|url=https://www.leopoldina.org/fileadmin/redaktion/Mitglieder/CV_Herrmann_Wolfgang_EN.pdf|access-date=27 December 2020|website=[[German National Academy of Sciences Leopoldina]]}}</ref>

== Career ==
Herrmann was appointed professor at the [[University of Regensburg]] in 1979. In 1982, he transferred to the [[Goethe University Frankfurt]]. In 1985, he succeeded Ernst Otto Fischer at the [[TUM Department of Chemistry|Department of Chemistry]] of the [[Technical University of Munich]]. From 1988 to 1990, he was [[Dean (education)|dean]] of the department.<ref name="Leopoldina"/>

In 1995, Herrmann was elected President of the [[Technical University of Munich]]. He was reelected in 1999, 2005, 2007 and 2013.

== Research ==
With an [[H-index|''h''-index]] of 106 (According to [[Scopus]]; {{asof|2021}}),<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.scopus.com/authid/detail.uri?authorId=8748371100|title=Scopus preview – Herrmann, Wolfgang Anton – Author details – Scopus|website=www.scopus.com|accessdate=19 December 2021}}</ref> Herrmann is one of the most highly cited German chemists, with more than 800 scientific publications and around 80 patents.

== Awards ==
*Honorary President of [[New Uzbekistan University]] (2021)
* Commander of the French [[Legion of Honour]] (2019)
* [[Bavarian Maximilian Order for Science and Art]] (2012)
* [[Bavarian Order of Merit]] (2007)
* Wilhelm Klemm Prize of the [[German Chemical Society]] (1995)
* Member of the [[German Academy of Sciences Leopoldina]] (1995)<ref>{{cite web |title= Wolfgang A. Herrmann |url=https://www.leopoldina.org/mitgliederverzeichnis/mitglieder/member/Member/show/wolfgang-a-herrmann/|publisher=German Academy of Sciences Leopoldina |access-date=1 June 2021}}</ref>
* Max Planck Research Award of the [[Humboldt Foundation]] (1991)
* [[Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz Prize]] of the [[German Research Foundation]] (1987)
* [[Klung Wilhelmy Science Award]] (1982)
